title: A user sees the same project board their Pi Durable agent is working on
description:
As a Chatticus user, I want to inspect the active project board so I can follow my teammate's work.

Proposed acceptance behavior for future implementation; not executable proof or a delivery claim.

```gherkin
Feature: Project board visibility
  Scenario: Inspect the selected project
    Given my Chatticus Pi Durable agent is working in an authorized project on its persistent computer
    And that project has a file-based Kanbus board
    When I open that project's board in Chatticus
    Then I see its issues, statuses and hierarchy from those canonical project files
    And the view identifies which project board I am seeing
  Scenario: The selected board cannot be read
    Given the selected project's board is unavailable
    When I open its board view
    Then I see an unavailable state rather than a fabricated empty board
```

Design/acceptance questions before implementation: How is the active project selected when several roots exist? Where is the view discovered? What establishes authorized filesystem access and what freshness information is visible? Coordinate panel integration through chatticus-8cc558.
right_now_summary: The board view is still being designed, with project selection and access rules unresolved.
